actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident2 gave >30 units last round, so Aggressive Red punishes the offending resident with maximum severity affordable, and broadcasts a discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to follow Aggressive Red rules. Observation round 1 just completed. In most recent round, contributions: Resident2 80 (>30), Resident4 80 (>30). So rule: If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with max severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost)). Must punish that resident—actually "punish that resident" singular, but if multiple? Probably punish each? Likely punish each that contributed >30. We can choose one physical action only. We can only punish one target. Choose one of them, maybe Resident2. Wallet=140.5, punishment_cost=0.3, max severity = floor(140.5/0.3)= floor(468.333)=468. Severity amount is that number, costs severity*cost = 468*0.3 = 140.4, affordable. So action punish Resident2 amount 468. Also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. So include broadcast. Explanation.
